items.title: OpenAI’s AI agents analyse a mouse brain gene atlas in 32 minutes
items.summary:
OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps Research have used close to 2,000 AI agents to analyse a large mouse brain dataset in 32 minutes. The team estimates that researchers working by hand would need months to a year for the same analysis, which OpenAI published on Wednesday. items.title: The AI vs AI Battle for the Internet
items.summary: Anthropic ships Claude Duet — and it still can't hold the main slot. A PHP vulnerability touching perhaps 70% of the web, a breach at Railway, and millions of AI-driven exploit attempts within hours of disclosure mark what may be the transition between two eras of cybersecurity: one where long-held norms made exploits manageable, and a new one where it's AI versus AI and the winner is whoever coordinates fastest.
items.whyItMatters: Policy and risk stories often become product constraints later, especially around data access, safety claims, export rules, and copyright.

brief.practicalImpact: Policy moves can become tomorrow's product limits, compliance burden, or availability issue.
